capabilities: Drag a table row above or below another row in the same group
Save a manual row sequence per Table view
Reset a view to its configured sorting
Store the order as vault-relative file paths in the view
disambiguation: Not a tool for reordering .base files or notes; it only changes the row order shown inside a Bases Table view.
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.15.1 or later; relies on internal parts of the built-in Table renderer, which may change in later app releases. Inline base code blocks are saved through Obsidian's native save action, which may normalize YAML formatting. Makes no network requests.
intentEvidence: Drag rows directly in Obsidian's built-in Bases Table view.
problem: Bases table views can only be ordered by their configured sort rules, so there is no way to arrange rows by hand.
summary: Adds drag handles to rows in Obsidian's Bases Table view and saves a manual row order for each view.
